name: children of the night
desc:
the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} magically calls 2d4 swarms of bats or rats, provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can call 3d6 wolves instead.
The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies, or until the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dismisses them as a bonus action.
